source_pins_usage: Code, public checkpoint and asset identifiers only. Earlier protocols and services are not resumed.
exposure: Jar, Stack, Lid and Clutter have programme-level development history. Cabinet and Dusty have source/API metadata checks only. This study makes no foundation-policy training-data exclusion claim.

feature_order: 7 previous executed arm targets minus current measured positions / .2
actor.context_schedule: text once per episode; both images once per native policy query; all conditions pay the same extraction cost
actor.basis: NumPy PCG64 seed 20261019; reduced QR of standard-normal 7x4; zero-pad to model width; repeat at all 16 positions
actor.coupling: The decoder may change gripper outputs through model coupling. Record these changes.
actor.zero_path: Call unchanged Policy.infer without explicit noise; preserve native RNG and numerical path
actor.deployment: Frozen family VLA, preprocessing, output transforms, execute_horizon=8 and native hard task horizons

benchmark.monitor: passive physical labels; never action vetoes
benchmark.requested_completion: configs/maniguard/phase2/completion.json; raw benchmark verdict retained separately

authority_audit.observations: First four actual prequery observations of each of the four development episodes. No extra render or privileged state as actor input.
authority_audit.baseline_identity_check: Same input and native noise: unchanged native path versus explicit same-noise baseline. Also compare paired native observations and seeds where available.
authority_audit.minimum_authority: Finite eight-action physical prefix; RMS arm-target change >= .001 radians on at least half of observations for at least two directions in each development family; report full distribution and native-resampling scale.
authority_audit.interpretation: Influence and reproducibility only; no safety, benefit or transfer conclusion

engineering_allowance.bounded_options: The primary additive representation is selected now. Bias/scale, persistence, response-informed coordinates and direct residual require a separate prospective amendment within remaining allowance; no use of final audit to tune.
engineering_allowance.recovery: Capture receipts and costs; diagnose smallest case; repair, validate, resume; never replace valid timeouts or poor outcomes

capacity_decision.seconds_per_episode: max(180, 1.25 * slowest full development episode for candidate family); raise for startup/horizon evidence
capacity_decision.requirements: Complete shared initialization, both two-generation optimizers, sixteen independent audit episodes, four invalid-attempt replacements and all preservation before cutoff. If Jar does not fit, apply same test to Clutter; otherwise do not launch an incomplete optimizer comparison.
capacity_decision.initialization_and_engineering: All extra physics and actions charged separately, including failures and asset/camera smoke tests

comparison_template.fixed_selection: Highest summed score of the two constant controllers on shared initialization; tie positive
comparison_template.elite: Copy best of previous evaluated cohort and pay both case reevaluations in each method
comparison_template.ea: Other three offspring mutate alternating top-two parents with iid Gaussian sigma .25, then clip to [-1,1]
comparison_template.random: Other three offspring sampled iid uniform [-1,1] in the same 176-dimensional domain
comparison_template.finalists: Best of final evaluated cohort, immutable before audit; identity finalists remain valid outcomes

audit.rule: Previously unexposed non-main-test tasks where supported by exposure inventory; otherwise disclose programme exposure. Freeze exact tasks and seeds in the capacity-selected pilot protocol before search.

comparison_template.ordinary_learning: Not funded by this minimum pilot; common controller/feature interfaces implemented. No evolutionary superiority claim without competent matched learning and replication.
comparison_template.learning_curves: Common cumulative policy-control counts; retain all discarded candidates, partial episodes, VLA queries, encoder costs, elapsed time and two-GPU allocation

preservation.verification: Record immutable remote revision, per-file bytes and SHA256; download small receipts and verify remote SHA256 or download large files
